eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CIVIL EMERGENCY MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Owyhee, ID; at 9:24 PM on JUL 25, 2026 Effective until 11:24 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Owyhee county has issued a civil emergency alert for the Reynolds Creek area and the town of Murphy wildfire in the area be prepared to evacuate.
